scripts.collie:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='./CollieAI_ERD/collieAI.sql';if(!fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim()){console.error('ERROR: CollieAI_ERD/collieAI.sql is empty. Add your PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE statements first.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.collie:build: npm run collie:check && npx --yes @liam-hq/cli erd build --input ./CollieAI_ERD/collieAI.sql --format postgres --output-dir ./CollieAI_ERD/dist
scripts.collie:preview: npm run collie:build && npm run collie:serve
scripts.payroll:build: npm run payroll:check && npx --yes @liam-hq/cli erd build --input ./Payroll_Erd/payroll.sql --format postgres --output-dir ./Payroll_Erd/dist
scripts.payroll:preview: npm run payroll:build && npm run payroll:serve
scripts.abyss:build: npm run abyss:check && npx --yes @liam-hq/cli erd build --input ./Abyss_ERD/abyss.sql --format postgres --output-dir ./Abyss_ERD/dist
scripts.abyss:preview: npm run abyss:build && npm run abyss:serve
